top_signals.title: Image rights: HMRC’s new tax rules for footballers take the biscuit
top_signals.summary: As well-known sports personalities, footballers can make a lot of money from exploiting their image, especially in the age of social media. As a bonus, they can put structures in place to minimise the tax take on these earnings. Not for much longer, though. HMRC has been scrutinising these arrangements, and from April 2028, new [...]
